statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat
The symptoms are concerning for arrhythmia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The service is to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate symptoms with potential cardiac events over an extended monitoring period
The denial reason code is CO-50
The service was not deemed medically necessary under Federal Medicare guidelines
The clinical documentation provided did not sufficiently establish the requirement for continuous ambulatory monitoring
